title: Trip Force Stopped Due to Device Not Found so we got partial report and dashboard even though the device is recovered later the data is still partial.
body:
**Source:** known limitations

**Source Bug ID:** 2

## Description
When a trip is force stopped because the device is not found, a partial report is generated. After the device is found again, although it has collected the remaining trip data, the dashboard and PDF report continue to display only the initial partial report instead of the complete trip data.

## Steps to Reproduce
Start a trip.

Simulate a "Device Not Found" scenario.

Force stop the trip.

Verify that a partial report is generated.

Restore the device connection.

Ensure the device continues to collect the remaining trip data.

Check the dashboard and generate the PDF report.

## Expected Result
Once the device is found and the remaining trip data is synchronized, the dashboard and PDF report should be updated to include the complete trip data.

The final report should reflect all data collected throughout the trip, including data collected after the device reconnects.

## Actual Result
The dashboard displays only the partial report generated at the time of the force stop.

The PDF report also contains only the partial trip data.

The remaining data collected after the device reconnects is not reflected in either the dashboard or the PDF.

## Severity
high

## Priority
high

## Evidence
https://gndsolutions.atlassian.net/browse/THNXFRSH-913
